A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same RAD-V/RAD-Q research with the same title and authors. Their main text, equations, figures, tables and Appendices A-G support reliable comparison despite repagination and relocated material.

before.justification: v3 reports original controlled-generation experiments, rank analyses, ablations and decoding-time measurements in Section 4 and the appendices.

after.justification: v4 retains those original results and adds matrix-completion results for HelpSteer and BeaverTails in Table 2.

M1.justification: The RAD-Q parametrization, baseline reward component, response and distillation losses, sampled-token regularization and guided decoding procedure remain unchanged in Sections 3.2-3.3.

E1.justification: Table 2 adds HelpSteer helpfulness and BeaverTails safety data to the matrix-completion analysis. Controlled-generation training and evaluation coverage remains unchanged; the new arithmetic example is theoretical.

E2.justification: Corresponding main-text and appendix comparisons retain the same comparator sets. Section 2.1 corrects the swapped GeDi and DExperts citations, while ARM/RAD legend changes rename existing methods.

E3.justification: Appendix E changes the stated weight decay from 0.02 to 0.01. Existing model configurations, evaluation metrics, sampling procedures and sample counts are retained. The PDFs do not establish that experiments were rerun following this reported setting revision.

E4.justification: The analysis testing whether reward data admit low-rank completions is extended to HelpSteer and BeaverTails. Existing regularization, reward-baseline, loss-choice, MLP and alternative-toxicity-classifier analyses are retained.

E5.justification: v4 introduces no new seed, repeated-run, confidence-interval or significance reporting. The added matrix-completion results use the existing MSE reporting practice, and sampling and numerical-rank estimation descriptions remain substantively unchanged.

E6.justification: Table 2 adds helpfulness and safety MSE columns, including rank-255 values of 1.04e-8 and 5.08e-8, respectively. Its original columns and the existing generation, ablation, timing and generated-example results are unchanged.

T1.justification: Section 3.1.4 adds Example 4: a binary arithmetic-correctness reward whose matrix contains all one-hot answer vectors and therefore has full rank. Existing definitions, lemmas, derivations and appendix proofs remain unchanged.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the central claims about the Q-style rank bottleneck and distilled RAD-Q matching RAD-V on detoxification and sentiment control with one reward-model call per generated token.

C2.justification: The arithmetic example identifies another concrete applicability boundary for low-rank modeling. Section 3.1.3 extends the low-rank interpretation to helpfulness and safety data. Existing toxicity and evaluation limitations remain in Appendix A.

D1.justification: v4 adds a RAD-Q code-repository link in Section 4.1 and documents linear learning-rate decay to zero in Appendix E. Task-specific learning rates and epoch counts were already present in v3; their movement from F.1-F.2 to E.1-E.2 is organizational.

R1.justification: v4 adds references concerning self-consistency, best-of-n decoding, HelpSteer, BeaverTails and multi-objective reward modeling. Brief additions clarify connections to decoding-time reinforcement learning without substantially redefining the paper's positioning.

P1.justification: There are local wording edits, short explanatory additions and publication-status text. Training subsections move into Appendix E, and the duplicated main-text limitations paragraph is removed while Appendix A is retained. The overall narrative structure remains stable.

P2.justification: Table 2 gains two dataset columns, and the LLaMa-2 plot moves from v3 Figure 16 in the appendix to v4 Figure 5 in the main text. Selected legends and plot borders are revised, sentiment panels share a consolidated caption, and publication headers cause reflow.

improvement.justification: The additional rank-completion evidence and arithmetic counterexample modestly strengthen the paper's treatment of applicability. The code link, learning-rate schedule disclosure and improved appendix organization also help reproducibility. These are limited gains over stable generation evidence; the unexplained weight-decay revision and some awkward wording edits remain drawbacks.
